name: Harley-Davidson U / UL Flathead
engine: 74 or 80 cubic inch air-cooled side-valve V-twin, recirculating oil
intro: The big flathead that ran beside the Knucklehead. Recirculating oil, hand shift and a strong club scene.

E: It is a flathead. The valves sit beside the cylinder, so set the tappets with the engine cold and check the valve guides for wear.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
